meta.name: hunt-grpc
meta.description: Hunt gRPC vulnerabilities — server reflection enabled (enumerate all services/methods), missing authentication / metadata-stripping on internal endpoints, plaintext gRPC over HTTP/2, internal endpoint disclosure, proto file leakage, gRPC-Web/grpc-gateway transcoding injection, and HTTP/2 Rapid Reset DoS (CVE-2023-44487). Use when target exposes port 50051 / 443 / 8443 / 9090 with HTTP/2, when grpcurl/grpcui detects reflection, when an Envoy or grpc-gateway proxy is fronting a microservice, or when recon reveals a microservice architecture.

copy.tagline: 扫描 gRPC 服务的安全漏洞
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果负责微服务安全，需要检测 gRPC 接口的常见漏洞。
copy.tagline_en: Scan gRPC services for security vulnerabilities
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are responsible for microservice security and need to detect common gRPC vulnerabilities.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能帮你检测 gRPC 服务的安全漏洞，比如反射接口暴露、缺少认证、内部端点泄露、明文传输、HTTP/2 快速重置拒绝服务攻击等。
howto.when: 当目标开放 50051、443、8443、9090 等端口且支持 HTTP/2，或 grpcurl/grpcui 检测到反射，或发现 Envoy/grpc-gateway 代理微服务时触发。

say.text: 扫描目标 example.com:50051 的 gRPC 反射服务。
测试 admin.AdminService/DeleteUser 是否无需认证。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you detect security vulnerabilities in gRPC services, such as exposed reflection interfaces, missing authentication, internal endpoint disclosure, plaintext transmission, and HTTP/2 Rapid Reset DoS attacks.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the target exposes ports 50051, 443, 8443, 9090 with HTTP/2, when grpcurl/grpcui detects reflection, or when an Envoy/grpc-gateway proxy is fronting a microservice.

say_en.text: Scan gRPC reflection on target example.com:50051.
Test if admin.AdminService/DeleteUser requires no auth.
Check if example.com:443 is vulnerable to CVE-2023-44487.
